sources.title: Digital Realty: Digital Realty breaks ground on new state-of-the-art data center in Switzerland (press release, 27 August 2026)
sources.summary: Digital Realty's press release, datelined 'ZURICH, Aug. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE)', announces the start of construction of ZUR4 in Glattbrugg (15 MW of IT capacity across about 6,300 m2, completion planned for 2028). It states that ZUR4 is planned to expand 'the already best-connected data center campus in Switzerland, comprising ZUR1, ZUR2, and ZUR3', that ZUR2 has been awarded the first SDEA PLATINUM Plus certification, and, quoting the company's Managing Director for Austria and Switzerland, that the company's continued investments in Zurich and across Europe include 'the ongoing construction of FRA20 in Frankfurt and VIE13 in Vienna', and that with ZUR4 and the continued expansion of the Glattbrugg campus it is creating an ecosystem that 'connects more than 200 customers on-site'. Forward-looking statements (ZUR4 capacity, completion in 2028) are forecasts.
sources.date_semantics: Release page date 'August 27, 2026', dateline 'ZURICH, Aug. 27, 2026', and the page's press-release timestamp 1787810520 (2026-08-27T06:02:00Z); the English sitemap gives lastmod 2026-08-27T06:06Z. The release date is used as a publication-normalized observation of what the release states in the present tense (the existing ZUR1-ZUR3 campus; the ongoing construction of FRA20); it is not an inspection, opening or construction-start day. This is a fresh capture (26 October 2026, 23:58 UTC) of the release that the 16 October update used as the ZUR4 status source; its bytes differ from that capture (different SHA-256), so it is recorded as a separate evidence capture with the same publication date.
